recipe.visualDefinition: A centered studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 1960s blonde hair, set against a seamless pale blue background that blends into the floor. The composition uses a mix of elegant script for the primary name and clean sans-serif for secondary details, characterized by a soft, diffused lighting style and a cool-toned pastel palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones against a cool monochromatic blue environment
Verticality of the bouffant hair contrasting with the horizontal lean of the body
Large-scale script title balanced by small-scale block text in the lower corner
Soft-focus edges of the subject blending into the background
coreInvariants: Monochromatic pale blue background and clothing
Heavy winged eyeliner and neutral lip

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, leaning forward from the right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the hair, follows the lean of the body down to the hands, then jumps to the script title on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and around the script title to provide a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Tan and Honey Blonde (Subject's skin and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value; the image feels bright but muted.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blues, tans, and whites

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with thick downstrokes and thin connectors
Fluid, hand-drawn quality with connected lowercase letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features a tall, narrow loop
Final letter terminates in a long, horizontal flourish

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats in negative space next to the subject
Placed over the subject's arm/torso area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, large-scale script with functional, small-scale geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem in top left corner

preserve: Script style for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual hand-drawn feel
Matches the clean, functional look of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with 1960s blonde bouffant hair, wearing a simple pale blue dress, leaning forward against a seamless pale blue studio backdrop. Soft, diffused lighting, cool color temperature.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant white script name in the upper right. Add a list of song titles in small, all-caps white sans-serif in the lower left corner. Place a small circular logo and serial number in the top left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent pale blue?
Does the hair have significant volume and 60s styling?
Is the script text large and fluid?
Is the secondary text in a clean, all-caps sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Background color (can be swapped for other pastels)
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color gradients in the background
Ensure the script text is legible despite its flourishes
Verify the subject's pose feels natural and elegant
Confirm the all-caps text is properly aligned and spaced
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-volume 60s portrait with a monochromatic pastel environment and a high-contrast script/sans-serif typographic layout.
